title: REQ · Store write stays consistent with scene focus and null when nothing is focused
summary: The id written to the store is derived once from the scene and is null when no object is focused
description: Context: the focused id is currently computed inline for the event. Desired behavior: a single private helper computes the focused id (null when none) and its result is used for both the store write and the focusChange event, so the later store-driven applyFocusedObject is a no-op. Expected result: no focus flicker or blur after a keyboard move. Why: single source of focus truth.
acceptance_criteria: Given no object isFocused after a move, when handled, then store focusedObjectId is null and focusChange emits id null.
Given the store write triggers onStateChange, when applyFocusedObject runs, then the focused object's blur is not called.

in_scope: Private helper in BootScene for the focused id

dependencies: REQ1 Act touches the same handler
definition_of_done: Store and event use the same computed id
